patent.title: 氮化钒的生产方法
assignees: 攀钢集团钒钛资源股份有限公司
patent.family_note: Holdout E4-N4 REPLACED primary (was wrongly nominated as ZL201010284583.7). Grant assignee 攀枝花钢铁(集团)公司; litigants 攀钢集团+攀钢钒钛. Single asserted patent in (2020)川01知民初505号. ZL201010284583.7 = defendant defense only. Expired 2021-12-04.

knowledge_origin.description: Public holdout; Panzhihua Iron & Steel group R&D; inventorship genealogy not reconstructed beyond grant inventors and 攀钢 litigants.

technology.problem: 氮化钒工业化：批次/真空工艺效率低、能耗高、连续进出料困难。
technology.mechanism: 钒氧化物+碳粉+粘结剂混匀压块成型→连续入炉→氮气/氨气保护→1000–1800℃碳化氮化（<6h）→保护气氛冷至100–250℃出炉得块/粒状高表观密度产品（claim 1；裁判 A–J 比对）。

value_carriers.name: 渝鑫被控氮化钒生产方法及直接获得产品（裁判认定侵权）
value_carriers.description: Court element match of Yuxin VN production method to claim 1 of ZL01139886.8; downstream Jinhui/Vanadium Jing sales of products obtained by the method. Carrier is adjudicated infringer process/product, not 攀钢 own plant revenue.

value_links.note: Implementation via adjudicated claim-1 process map.

value_metrics.metric_name: court-awarded patent infringement damages and costs (all defendants)
value_metrics.note: Dispute-specific E4 with contribution-rate discount. Primary = ZL01139886.8 only (replaced nominee).

gaps.description: Relative to T0=2026-10-13 the invention expired 2021-12-04 (days after judgment); E4 is historical damages realization with discretionary contribution-rate/profit-band apportionment, not a live royalty or audited plant-level patent price.
needed_evidence: Plant-level profit audit tied to claim elements

gaps.description: No independent field-normalized quality score beyond infringement; defendant raised ZL201010284583.7 as alternative process narrative (defense only).

notes: Holdout E4-N4. T0=2026-10-13. REPLACED primary → ZL01139886.8. Single-ZL court E3+E4+E5 → R5. Claims-check PASS (court claim 1). Expired vs T0 → historical damages gaps. Judgment≠auto R5 without E3/exact_patent—those are present. Not V0.8; not intrinsic price.
